Background execution and child processes
From Android 12, the system may end long tasks (signal 9). Some Android 14 devices offer “Disable child process restrictions” in Developer options.
For long tasks, run termux-wake-lock to stay awake and termux-wake-unlock when done. Uses more battery.
If tasks stop in the background, allow full background activity for both &brand; and Termux.

5 · Let the Agent use Termux files

Mounts belong to a session. In a chat, open External folders, choose Authorize a folder, and pick Termux in the system picker. File tools then use /mnt/alias/; commands run by Termux keep using the Termux home folder.
